'''Charred fish''' is a [[food]] item made by cooking any fish in a [[Mud Kiln]]. It heals {{Value|Charred Fish|heals}}, less than a properly cooked fish.

== Obtaining ==
=== Cooking ===
Any cod, salmon, pufferfish or tropical fish, including all custom [[fish]], turns into charred fish in a mud kiln in {{Value|Charred Fish|cook_time}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/kiln/charred_fish.json}}</ref>
{{Recipes}}

== Usage ==
=== Food ===
Eating it gives a hidden Regeneration IV for 15 ticks, which heals {{Value|Charred Fish|heals}}.
